name: NEOMYCIN / LIDOCAINE 0.350/2GR EAR DROPS SOLUTION 20 ML 1 PIECE
description: Neomycin and lidocaine ear drops are used to treat external ear infections. The antibiotic neomycin fights bacteria, while lidocaine acts as a local anesthetic to relieve pain. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
